features.title: Coloured or unpainted scenery
features.description: Switch the asset library and scene between their original colours and a plain unpainted view. Your choice is remembered on this PC; OpenLOCK geometry stays the same.

features.title: Browse in a bigger workspace
features.description: The expanded library keeps appearance, category and subcategory controls together.

features.title: Full-detail printable assets
features.description: The client supports larger high-definition printable pieces while retaining file validation and preserving saved scenes.
